name: Deck Essentials for Spotify
author: grant
summary: Control Spotify from StreamController, including Stream Deck+ dials.
description: Playback, seek, shuffle, repeat, volume, mute, Like/Unlike, Add to Playlist, device transfer and a one-key now-playing Song Stack, plus five Stream Deck+ dial actions: Playback Control, Volume Control, My Playlists, a Queue Picker and a Song Picker that scrolls any album, playlist or your Liked Songs. Authentication uses OAuth PKCE with a Client ID you create yourself; no client secret is ever requested and tokens are kept outside exportable page settings.
requirements: A Spotify Premium account (Spotify's playback-control endpoints are Premium-only)
Your own Spotify Developer app Client ID with http://127.0.0.1/callback registered as a redirect URI
Network access from StreamController to api.spotify.com
